reich.thema.regional.satz: For a province, region or the whole country: price, duration and effect follow the scope; once per place.
reich.thema.verkehr.satz: Routes to Central Asia and China, ports and mega links: each stage requires the previous one and partners along the route.
reich.thema.energie.satz: Grid interconnection, nuclear, fusion and water transfers: first research and treaties, then plants.
reich.thema.stadt.satz: From new districts to a new capital: creating housing costs forest, water and trust.
reich.thema.raumfahrt.satz: From the agency to Mars: each stage builds on the previous one, and none is cheap.
reich.thema.ki.satz: Strategy, data centres, chips and applications: dependent on electricity, talent and suppliers.
reich.thema.technologie.satz: Very large investments in sea, air, biology, chips, batteries, quantum, robotics and materials: long duration, uncertain breakthroughs, competition and espionage, late returns with side effects.
